svg.title: Sequential baseline block diagram — one MAC, same host interface as the accelerator
svg.desc: seq_matmul keeps the same ports, address map and host protocol as systolic_top. Operand storage holds A and B. Row, column and k counters address the storage. A single multiplier and adder form one MAC; the running sum restarts at zero, or at the stored C element on an accumulate run. Each finished element is written to the C store in the cycle of its last product. The sequencer is busy for N squared times k_len cycles.
